data.name: Parmod
data.gender_notes: Parmod is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Parmod is derived from Parma (Supreme) and Dev (God). This name signifies the one who is the lord of the universe, the supreme being. In Hindu mythology, Parmod is an epithet for various deities, including Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu. The name Parmod carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Parmod usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Parmod belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parmod total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
